summary: A maintenance patch. The workflows that build, document and release this project move to the current GitHub Actions releases, and the repo-root `prek` floor follows the lock. No Python dependency, source file, MCP tool or CLI command changes.

sections.title: ⬆️ Upgraded
items: `astral-sh/setup-uv` 10.3.0 → 10.3.2 across `ci.yml`, `docs.yml` and `release.yml`; still pinned to a full commit SHA (`07a047e6…`).
`pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` 1.14.2 → 1.14.3 in `release.yml`; still pinned to a full commit SHA (`7245906f…`).
`prek` requirement `>=0.5.5` → `>=0.5.7` in the repo-root `pyproject.toml`; the lock already resolved 0.5.7, so only its recorded specifier moves.

sections.title: 📝 Notes
sections.items: Nothing under `apps/server/src` changes and no Python dependency in `uv.lock` moves, so this release is safe to take on its own; the published wheel differs from 0.7.0 only in its version string. If you vendor the lock files, the only delta is the recorded `prek` specifier and the project's own version.

upgrade_notes: No breaking changes to the shipped API, CLI, MCP tools or documentation URLs. The 0.6.0 opt-in for `director_tool`'s `emotion` / `emotion_level` (requires the `X-MCP-Insiders` header) still applies.
